title: Phase-Interference Energy and the Formal Structure of the PG1224 Prime Generation System
description: This research note reformulates the elementary number-theoretic structure of natural numbers using the operational concept of phase-interference energy. It defines interference energy as a measure of non-trivial divisors, clarifies the boundary condition excluding 0 and 1 through the domain condition 2 ≤ n, and sketches a Lean 4 formalization of the equivalence among Nat.Prime n, interferenceEnergy n = 0, and isStableFixedPoint n. The note also introduces PG1224, a prime-candidate generation system based on residue-class filtering modulo 12 and 24, interpreted as cancellation of trivial interference caused by divisibility by 2 and 3. The English manuscript is canonical; the Japanese manuscript is included as a companion translation.
